wholePhysicalScope: Native measured building outline and roof and dome sections, the state’s architectural description, and public-domain photographic evidence.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the limestone wings, projecting Ionic porticoes and domed rotunda with its lantern.
limitations: The present Capitol shell, all four architectural elevations and attached porticoes. Free-standing statues, the landscaping layout and interior rooms are outside scope.
The lantern is scaled to the state’s published 212-foot dome height. Unpublished molding profiles, minor roof positions and decorative relief are estimated.
